K5.6 (K80 Metric) · 68°C

Standard Response Fire Sprinklers

DN15 standard-response automatic fire sprinklers with K5.6 (K80 metric), available in upright, pendent and horizontal sidewall configurations. The main gallery and model table show the 68°C red-bulb versions.

K5.6 US / K80 metric DN15 / ½ in nominal connection Upright / Pendent / Horizontal Sidewall 68°C / 155°F · red glass bulb
Ask on WhatsApp Available models

BSPT is the default thread; NPT is available. Select your temperature, frame material and installation orientation when requesting a quotation.

Compare the upright, pendent and horizontal sidewall 68°C samples in the main gallery. Additional temperature samples are shown in Product photographs below; each caption identifies the photographed configuration.
